BoyerMooreSearch.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the object by storing the input text and pattern and precomputing their lengths." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> text </REF>: string "The text input to store and measure."
        <REF> pattern </REF>: string "The pattern input to store and measure."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign self.text to the input parameter text. RESULT self.text]
            [COMMAND Assign self.pattern to the input parameter pattern. RESULT self.pattern]
            [COMMAND Assign self.textLen to len(text), computed from the original input parameter text. RESULT self.textLen]
            [COMMAND Assign self.patLen to len(pattern), computed from the original input parameter pattern. RESULT self.patLen]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BoyerMooreSearch.match_in_pattern:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Searches self.pattern in reverse and returns the highest index where char occurs, or -1 if char is not present." match_in_pattern]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> char </REF>: str "Character or element to search for in self.pattern."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> matched_index </REF>: int "The highest index i such that self.pattern[i] equals char; otherwise -1."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Scan self.pattern in reverse by iterating i over range(self.patLen - 1, -1, -1), which produces indices from self.patLen - 1 down to 0 inclusive; when self.patLen is 0, this sequence is empty. RESULT reverse_scan]
            [COMMAND Within the reverse scan over i, if char equals self.pattern[i], immediately return i. RESULT matched_index]
            [COMMAND If the reverse scan completes without finding an equal element, return -1. RESULT not_found_index]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BoyerMooreSearch.mismatch_in_text:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Compares the pattern against the text starting at currentPos from right to left and returns the first mismatch position, or -1 if all pattern characters match." mismatch_in_text]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> currentPos </REF>: int "Starting index in self.text where self.pattern is compared."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: int "Absolute text index of the first mismatch found from the right, or -1 if no mismatch is found."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND For i from self.patLen - 1 down to 0 inclusive, decrementing by 1 each iteration, compare self.pattern[i] with self.text[currentPos + i]. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND After the backward loop completes without an early return, return -1. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Inside the backward loop over i, self.pattern[i] is not equal to self.text[currentPos + i].]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return currentPos + i immediately as the absolute mismatch position. RESULT mismatch_position]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BoyerMooreSearch.bad_character_heuristic:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Scans every alignment of the pattern against the text and returns the starting indices where the pattern matches completely." bad_character_heuristic]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> positions </REF>: list[int] "Starting indices in self.text where self.mismatch_in_text(i) returns -1, meaning a full pattern match was found."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize an empty list named positions to collect match start indices. RESULT positions]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 through self.textLen - self.patLen inclusive, using Python range(self.textLen - self.patLen + 1); if self.textLen < self.patLen, the range is empty and the loop body does not execute. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop over i, set mismatch_index to the return value of self.mismatch_in_text(i). RESULT mismatch_index]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop over i, if mismatch_index equals -1, append i to positions. RESULT positions]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop over i, if mismatch_index does not equal -1, set match_index to the return value of self.match_in_pattern(self.text[mismatch_index]). RESULT match_index]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop over i, if mismatch_index does not equal -1, assign i = mismatch_index - match_index; note that this assignment does not affect the next value produced by the Python for loop over range. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND After the loop completes, return positions. RESULT positions]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
